title: Fall of Edo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Fall of Edo", at revision 1370617738, opens: "The Fall of Edo , also known as Edojō Akewatashi  and Edo Muketsu Kaijō , took place in May and July 1868, when the Japanese capital of Edo, controlled by the Tokugawa shogunate, fell to forces favorable to the restoration of Emperor Meiji during the Boshin War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q715559, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
